home.title: Book a doctor without the waiting-room guesswork
home.lede: Clinics on this platform publish their real schedules. Pick a time, get your token, and see when you'll be called.
home.tokenStatus: About 25 minutes. 4 people ahead of you.
home.forClinicsBody: Staff sign in to manage schedules, the daily queue and walk-ins.

auth.signInLede: Use the email and password your clinic set up, or a code sent to your phone.
auth.codeSent: We sent a code to {phone}. It expires in 5 minutes.
auth.invalidCredentials: That email and password don't match. Check them and try again.
auth.invalidPhone: Enter a Pakistani mobile number, like 0300 1234567.
auth.invalidCode: That code is wrong or has expired. Request a new one.
auth.tooManyAttempts: Too many attempts. Wait a minute, then try again.
auth.idleSignedOut: You were signed out after a period of inactivity. Sign in again to continue.
auth.twoFactorLede: Open your authenticator app and enter the 6-digit code for Clinic Appointments.
auth.genericError: Sign-in didn't work. Try again in a moment.
